payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the manual Pyramid scores used in summarization evaluation, particularly in the context of scientific articles.

claims.text: The Pyramid scoring framework organizes content units in tiers, with higher tiers indicating greater importance.
Pyramid scores are used to evaluate the quality of candidate summaries against gold human-written summaries.
The Pyramid evaluation framework is semi-manual and assesses the presence of important content units in summaries.
Pyramid scores correlate with various automatic evaluation metrics, including Rouge and Sera.
